header.note: derived from assets/geo (see SOURCES.md). x east, y north, local TM on P0, ints x 0.1 m.

schema.trees: [x, y, canopy_r, kind] kind 2 = generated in OSM wood, 3 = generated on other park land
schema.street_trees: [x, y, canopy_r] 2015 Street Tree Census, alive, inside 3 km but outside street.json square; r = 0.5*(1.5+0.2*DBH_cm) clamp 1..14
schema.wall: Central Park perimeter wall polylines (flat [x0,y0,...]), gaps at paths/roads, none along the Met plaza
schema.blocks: parallel to manhattan.json blocks: [h (0.1 m, -1 unknown), coverage %, park %, inside_ues_circle, src (1 = from ues footprints, 0 = manhattan PLUTO)]
schema.bld_block: parallel to ues.json buildings: index of the manhattan block containing the building (-1 none)
